name: an active announce with no hops
an ANNOUNCE_START carries its cost and the retired second field at the ceiling
an ANNOUNCE_END retracts by id
a body too short for its fields is malformed, not a wait for more (fuzz regression)
a lite-06 body too short for its path is malformed, not a wait for more (fuzz regression)
a lite-07 body too short for its path base is malformed, not a wait for more (fuzz regression)
a ROUTE_START names its publisher, suffix, and offer: a path of node and session hops, then flags, priority, and metric
a ROUTE_START's suffix extends the requested prefix, and its 0x2 flag carries an RTT in milliseconds
a Route Offer's 0x4 flag marks a path through a draining node
a Route Offer's RTT flag without its RTT is refused
a Route Offer flag no version defines is withdrawn, with whatever field it adds
a Route Offer with more than 32 hops is withdrawn
a Route Offer with no hops is refused
a Route Offer missing a hop it counts is refused
a ROUTE_START naming Node ID 0 is withdrawn
a Route Offer hop naming Node ID 0 is withdrawn
a ROUTE_START suffix no path spells is withdrawn
a ROUTE_UPDATE references its Route ID
a ROUTE_UPDATE flag no version defines is withdrawn
a ROUTE_HOLD references its Route ID
a ROUTE_END references its Route ID
a DEAD CLOSED names the hop, the far node, Gone, and the routes that moved, each offer sized
a DEAD CLOSED moved offer this node refuses is withdrawn, and the entries after it still read
a DEAD CLOSED moved offer short of its size is refused
a DEAD DRAIN names the node that sent GOAWAY
a DEAD of a kind no version defines is refused
a DEAD whose Gone is neither 0 nor 1 is refused
a DEAD naming Far Node ID 0 is refused
an ANNOUNCE_FLOOR carries its Revision plus one
an ANNOUNCE_FLOOR of 0 certifies nothing
a lite-07 ANNOUNCE_START names its Route ID in place of a hop chain
a lite-07 ANNOUNCE_START with an invalid path is withdrawn
a lite-07 ANNOUNCE_START with an invalid instance is withdrawn
a lite-07 ANNOUNCE_START cut short is refused
an ANNOUNCE_INIT within the announce budget
an ANNOUNCE_INIT listing more broadcasts than the budget is refused before its paths decode
an ANNOUNCE_INIT one byte past one storage segment is refused at its length prefix
a group sequence at 2^62-1, the largest a QUIC varint holds
a group sequence at 2^64-1, the largest a u64 holds
a server pinned to a version the client offered selects it
a server pinned to a version the client did not offer refuses
